title: PiBot Documentation Maintenance Directive
purpose: Define mandatory documentation maintenance requirements for all implementation and documentation changes.
source_prompt: User request to create Prompt_Header.md and prompt_header.json in /docs/
assumptions: prompts/ may not exist in this workspace snapshot.
directive_statement: Documentation is part of the implementation. Any modification to behavior, interfaces, architecture, configuration, protocols, threading, networking, or runtime characteristics is incomplete until all affected documentation has been updated and cross-referenced.

directive.repository_status: This repository is under active development. Treat all documentation as living engineering documentation.
pre_change_requirements: Read and understand all existing documentation in the docs/ directory and all relevant files in the prompts/ directory.
Treat system_manifest.json as the authoritative index of the current implementation unless the code indicates otherwise.
Validate documentation against the current implementation rather than assuming it is correct.
If implementation differs from documentation, update the documentation to match the implementation.
Preserve existing document structure and expand it instead of replacing it whenever practical.

when_creating_new_document: Update any documentation indexes if present.
Reference the prompt used to generate the document.

pre_change_requirements: If code changes modify architecture, interfaces, configuration, threading, networking, data flow, diagnostics, or runtime behavior, update all affected documentation before considering the task complete.
Never leave documentation in a partially updated state.

completion_summary_must_list: Any documentation that should be reviewed manually

guidance: Whenever possible, generate diagrams, tables, indexes, and cross-references that make the documentation easier to maintain.
Do not duplicate information unnecessarily. Reference existing documents when appropriate and extend them instead of creating conflicting documentation.

revision_history.change: Initial creation of machine-readable prompt header directive.
